claude_proposed_widenings.name: PassiveMechanics.auraScope
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Aura of Courage grants frightened immunity to the paladin AND all allies within a 10-ft emanation. PassiveMechanics has no attachment or area scope concept — its grants are implicitly bearer-only. Encoding just the bearer's immunity produces a provably false trace that omits the defining mechanic of the feature.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You and your allies have Immunity to the Frightened condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a Frightened ally enters the aura, that condition has no effect on that ally while there.
